record_title: Finite-prime perturbations and dependent prime-index asymptotics
provenance: Scientific derivation from the one-generator strong asymptotic and extended Ingham theorem of Vernaeve--Vindas--Weiermann, combined with the cofinite numerical-semigroup structure of multiplicatively dependent two-generator index sets.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.19434v1 was submitted on 16 September 2026, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. A 2017 seminar announcement by Lenny Neyt is described by Golafshan as concerning strong asymptotics for multiplicatively generated prime-index sets; no complete source establishing the dependent rank-one formula was identified for inspection. The theorem keeps m and all finite perturbations fixed; no uniformity for varying generators is claimed. The finite verification artifact supports the numerical-semigroup examples but is not a substitute for the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
